caption: 01 · CREATIVE — What can be approved?. Define the domain: collection, silhouette, casting, campaign, store environment, brand aesthetic, collaborator, or final release. “Creative control” without subject, threshold, and override mechanism is a slogan, not an operational record.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: 02 · GOVERNANCE — Who directs the company?. For a Delaware corporation, start with the certificate, bylaws, board composition, delegated authority, and §141. Then inspect committees, reserved matters, stockholder rights, and actual agreements rather than assuming the creative title controls the enterprise.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who directs the company? within Creative Control Is Not Economic Control.

caption: 03 · ECONOMICS — Who receives value and bears risk?. Equity ownership, voting rights, salary, royalty, bonus, license income, liquidation preference, debt covenants, and sale proceeds are distinct economic or control mechanisms. Public proxy and annual-report disclosures can demonstrate some layers while leaving private arrangements unknown.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: 04 · FAILURE TEST — What happens after conflict or departure?. Map removal, termination, good-reason provisions, cure periods, post-term use, transition duties, archive access, approval survival, and dispute procedure. Authority that exists only while a title is held may disappear differently from voting power or asset ownership.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: Legal architecture cannot manufacture trust or artistic judgment. A founder with extensive formal rights can still fail to lead; a creative director with limited equity can still exercise enormous cultural power. The map is useful because it prevents cultural influence from being mistaken for enforceable authority—and prevents formal authority from being mistaken for artistic legitimacy.
